name: ai-input-output-system
description: Local-first AI request routing for VS Code: answer simple prompts with a local 4B model, forward only complex work to the cloud.

commands.title: AI I/O: Route Prompt (Local or Cloud)
AI I/O: Create Files From Requirement
AI I/O: 给选区加注释

aiio.cloudBaseUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL used when a request is routed to the cloud.

aiio.cloudApiKey.markdownDescription: API key for the cloud endpoint. Stored in VS Code settings; prefer a secret-managed proxy in shared machines.

aiio.cloudModel.description: Model name sent to the cloud endpoint.

aiio.localServerUrl.description: Base URL of a running llama.cpp llama-server instance.

aiio.localModelPath.description: Absolute path to the local GGUF model. Empty means ./models inside the extension workspace.

aiio.routingThreshold.description: Complexity score above which a request is sent to the cloud. Lower means more cloud traffic.

aiio.enableLocalRouting.description: When disabled every request goes to the cloud.

aiio.collectRoutingFeedback.description: Ask for feedback after a locally answered prompt, feeding the decision-quality journal.

aiio.adaptiveRouting.description: Adapt the effective routing threshold downward from collected feedback. It only tightens (sends more to the cloud) and never rises above aiio.routingThreshold.

aiio.localHealthAware.description: Let local server availability and recently observed latency take part in the routing decision.

aiio.escalationEnabled.description: Let the local model escalate complex requests to a remote expert: the local model answers everything first and, when out of its depth, emits an [ESCALATE] marker with a focused sub-question that the cloud answers.

aiio.classifierWeights.description: Advanced: override classifier coefficients (baseScore, complexIntentBonus, simpleIntentPenalty, multiFileBonus, ...). Unset keys keep the tuned defaults.

aiio.autonomousOnStartup.description: When enabled, the extension creates files from aiio.autonomousRequirement on activation.

aiio.autonomousRequirement.description: Natural-language requirement used for autonomous file creation. Empty disables the startup run.

aiio.targetSubdirectory.description: Workspace-relative subdirectory where autonomously generated files are written.
